note: Wave D lane analytics_regime: the read-only regime overlay (GET /regime, GET /regime/data) over the bed's stored evaluations, exposure rows, index series, breadth readings, snapshots and rebalance plans; then the same pages after the settings page moves the knobs the view reads (REGIME_MODE, the R4 cap, the stale allowance, MIN_POSITION_WEIGHT, TARGET_POSITIONS, CLUSTER_CAP), then reset. No case writes anything but the settings rows. Run on the bed with --env REGIME_ENABLED=true until the integrator wires session::startup (main._apply_stored_settings) into the Rust desk's boot: the bed stores the override REGIME_ENABLED=true, Python applies it at startup and Rust does not yet, so without the flag the three cases before the first settings save differ only in regime_enabled. With it, 9/9 EQUAL on postgres; 9/9 EQUAL on sqlite (empty store) either way. Edge cases (wave D review): pre-open clock, a query string, POST and HEAD (FastAPI's GET-only 405 with Allow: GET), a trailing slash (Starlette's redirect_slashes 307 — an app-wide routing behaviour the Rust desk does not have yet), enforce mode with every other regime knob moved including REGIME_WEEKLY_EVAL_WEEKDAY (Python keeps the choice as a str, so regime_config() raises TypeError and both routes answer 500 until reset — reproduced in Rust, R-ar.1), a refused save, coverage 0 / buffer 0 / confirm 1, and a final reset.
